brief:
The U.S. government has indicted four additional pro-Palestine activists on conspiracy charges related to demonstrations at the University of Michigan, Mondoweiss reported. The new indictments bring the total number of defendants facing charges to 12, with sentences potentially ranging from five years to several decades.

The charges stem from protest activity at the campus, part of a broader series of prosecutions targeting Palestine activism in Michigan. The escalating legal action marks an intensification of federal cases against organizers and participants in pro-Palestine demonstrations.
dek: Four more pro-Palestine activists have been indicted on "conspiracy" charges stemming from protests at the University of Michigan, bringing the total to 12. The defendants now face sentences ranging from five years to several decades.
title: U.S. indicts four more Michigan activists on Palestine protest charges
